titleEn: Find Winner on a Tic Tac Toe Game
title: 找出井字棋的获胜者
summary: A、B 依次在三乘三棋盘落子，给定合法移动序列，返回获胜者、平局或仍待继续。
insight: A 的每步记 +1、B 记 -1，累计各行、各列和两条对角线；任何绝对值达到三即对应玩家获胜。
pitfalls: 未获胜且九步走满才是 Draw
不足九步且无人胜出返回 Pending

solutions.title: 带符号行线计数
solutions.idea: 用八条可能获胜线的代数和即时判断。
steps: 第 move 项分数 A 为一、B 为负一，更新对应行列与可能对角线
若任一绝对值为三返回当前玩家；扫描完按步数返回 Draw 或 Pending

code.java: class Solution { public String tictactoe(int[][] moves){int[] rows=new int[3],columns=new int[3];int diagonal=0,antiDiagonal=0;for(int i=0;i<moves.length;i++){int score=i%2==0?1:-1,r=moves[i][0],c=moves[i][1];rows[r]+=score;columns[c]+=score;if(r==c)diagonal+=score;if(r+c==2)antiDiagonal+=score;if(Math.abs(rows[r])==3||Math.abs(columns[c])==3||Math.abs(diagonal)==3||Math.abs(antiDiagonal)==3)return score==1?"A":"B";}return moves.length==9?"Draw":"Pending";} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun tictactoe(moves:Array<IntArray>):String{val rows=IntArray(3);val columns=IntArray(3);var diagonal=0;var antiDiagonal=0;for(i in moves.indices){val score=if(i%2==0)1 else -1;val r=moves[i][0];val c=moves[i][1];rows[r]+=score;columns[c]+=score;if(r==c)diagonal+=score;if(r+c==2)antiDiagonal+=score;if(kotlin.math.abs(rows[r])==3||kotlin.math.abs(columns[c])==3||kotlin.math.abs(diagonal)==3||kotlin.math.abs(antiDiagonal)==3)return if(score==1)"A" else "B"};return if(moves.size==9)"Draw" else "Pending"} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string tictactoe(vector<vector<int>>& moves){int rows[3]={},columns[3]={},diagonal=0,antiDiagonal=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)moves.size();++i){int score=i%2? -1:1,r=moves[i][0],c=moves[i][1];rows[r]+=score;columns[c]+=score;if(r==c)diagonal+=score;if(r+c==2)antiDiagonal+=score;if(abs(rows[r])==3||abs(columns[c])==3||abs(diagonal)==3||abs(antiDiagonal)==3)return score==1?"A":"B";}return moves.size()==9?"Draw":"Pending";} };
